bio.text: Neil Rafferty represents House District 54 (Jefferson County) in the Alabama House of Representatives, where he has served since 2018.
He holds bachelor's degrees in English and political science and in biology from the University of Alabama at Birmingham, graduating magna cum laude.
The legislature's profile lists his service in the U.S. Marine Corps from 2005 to 2009 as a noncommissioned officer and Operation Enduring Freedom veteran.
It lists his profession as community health project director.
